subsetPolicyRationale: `s.gis.gismap@1` is this plugin's own self-contained GIS map document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-position, delete-position, replace-position-data, reorder-positions, create-route, delete-route, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
